obligations.requirement: Authenticate independently captured typed World and exact frame; reject manufactured endpoint kinds, roots or selections.
Interpret the independently owned Selection for the exact source Resolution, subject, decision, role and frame.
Prove independently captured payload and source projections correspond to the typed catalogs used by Addresses.
Establish authenticity and policy legitimacy of metadata capture; list membership is insufficient.
Establish authenticity of independently issued typed payload role bindings and roots.
Prove or explicitly justify supported bytes-to-AST correspondence, including object entry preservation.
Connect exact schema revision to the source schema string and supported profile.
Interpret source node identity and entity kind under owned registries.
Interpret holder, ownership and scope entitlement without equating namespace labels with authority.
Interpret complete source bytes, digest correspondence and exact owner review.
Interpret source status and as-of freshness under the selected profile.
Resolve complete evidence list and admissibility posture.
Interpret owned challenge mechanism or its explicitly descriptive profile role.
Interpret exact successor records without silently selecting a newer source.
Interpret relation reference kind, direction and counterpart; resolve the actual Selection witness separately.
Interpret exact supported claim tier and reject stronger conclusions.
Establish typed Intent, decision, selected/excluded subjects and test roles.
Resolve exact owned resolution qualifier token with aliases and non-equivocation handled.
Resolve the addressing role for the exact selected role and endpoint kind.
